title: Shot events
description: Output of process(): one entry per resolved shot attempt, in time order. expected_events.json in fixtures uses the same shape, but there only 'shot' and 'outcome' are required; t_start, t_resolve and reason are checked when present (times with ±1 frame tolerance).

t_start.description: Ball entered the approach zone moving down.

t_resolve.description: Frame time at which the outcome was decided.
